elements.requirement: Section 63L governs section 63D material that relates to an individual who is issued a penalty notice under section 2 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001 and against whom no proceedings are brought for the offence to which that penalty notice relates.
elements.quote: relates to a person who is given a penalty notice under section 2 of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001 and in respect of whom no proceedings are brought for the offence to which the notice relates

elements.requirement: Section 63L applies only to section 63D material that was taken (or, for a DNA profile, derived from a sample taken) from the recipient of the penalty notice in connection with investigating the offence to which the penalty notice relates.
elements.quote: was taken (or, in the case of a DNA profile, derived from a sample taken) from the person in connection with the investigation of the offence to which the notice relates

elements.requirement: Fingerprints subject to section 63L may be retained for a period of 2 years starting on the date the fingerprints were taken.
elements.quote: in the case of fingerprints, for a period of 2 years beginning with the date on which the fingerprints were taken

elements.requirement: A DNA profile subject to section 63L derived from a single sample may be retained for a period of 2 years starting on the date the DNA sample was taken.
elements.quote: in the case of a DNA profile, for a period of 2 years beginning with— (i) the date on which the DNA sample from which the profile was derived was taken

elements.requirement: A DNA profile subject to section 63L derived from more than one DNA sample may be retained for a period of 2 years starting on the date the first of those samples was taken.
elements.quote: if the profile was derived from more than one DNA sample, the date on which the first of those samples was taken

thresholds.quote: for a period of 2 years beginning with the date on which the fingerprints were taken

thresholds.what: Retention period for a DNA profile
thresholds.quote: for a period of 2 years beginning with
